mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_prize_pool (name, description, prize_type, prize_ref_id, prize_value, prize_name, prize_desc, total_stock, claimed_count, per_user_limit, per_user_daily_limit, daily_limit, start_time, end_time, status, banner_text, banner_color, banner_color_end, sort) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{prizeType}, #{prizeRefId}, #{prizeValue}, #{prizeName}, #{prizeDesc}, #{totalStock}, 0, #{perUserLimit}, #{perUserDailyLimit}, #{dailyLimit}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{bannerText}, #{bannerColor}, #{bannerColorEnd}, #{sort})
mapper.update:
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool
name = #{name}, description = #{description}, prize_type = #{prizeType}, prize_ref_id = #{prizeRefId}, prize_value = #{prizeValue}, prize_name = #{prizeName}, prize_desc = #{prizeDesc}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, per_user_limit = #{perUserLimit}, per_user_daily_limit = #{perUserDailyLimit}, daily_limit = #{dailyLimit}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, status = #{status}, banner_text = #{bannerText}, banner_color = #{bannerColor}, banner_color_end = #{bannerColorEnd}, sort = #{sort},
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool SET claimed_count = claimed_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND (total_stock = -1 OR claimed_count < total_stock)
UPDATE marketing_prize_pool SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_prize_pool p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0
SELECT FROM marketing_prize_pool p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.start_time <= NOW() AND p.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY p.sort DESC, p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.banner_text, p.banner_color, p.banner_color_end, p.description, p.sort, p.prize_type, p.prize_name FROM marketing_prize_pool p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.start_time <= NOW() AND p.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY p.sort DESC

SELECT FROM marketing_prize_pool p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY p.sort DESC, p.create_time DESC
